intents.name: send_email
intents.description: Send transactional or marketing email via Resend
examples:
Send an email to john@example.com with subject Welcome and html content

Hello!

Email jane@company.com from noreply@mydomain.com subject Newsletter html

News
Send email to user@test.com subject Test text Hello World

intents.name: check_email_status
intents.description: Check delivery status of a sent email
examples: What's the delivery status for email id xyz-789

intents.name: list_emails
intents.description: List sent emails with optional filters

intents.name: verify_domain
intents.description: Verify a sending domain in Resend

intents.name: manage_contacts
examples: Add contact john@example.com to audience abc-123
Update contact jane@example.com in audience xyz-789 first name Jane

intents.name: manage_templates
intents.description: Manage email templates (create, list, send, update, delete)
examples:
Create template welcome_email subject Welcome {{name}} html

Hi {{name}}!
Send template tpl_123 to user@example.com from onboarding@myapp.com variables {"name":"John"}
Update template tpl_123 subject New Subject

intents.name: manage_audiences
intents.description: Manage Resend audiences (create, list, get, update, delete)
examples: Update audience abc-def name new name

intents.name: run_ab_test
intents.description: Run an A/B test between two email variants
examples: Run A/B test summer_promo to two segments
A/B test subject lines for newsletter

intents.name: schedule_campaign
intents.description: Schedule a campaign for future delivery
examples: Schedule newsletter to send tomorrow morning

examples: Create tenant acme with re_xxx key pro plan
